messages:
Nora (PM): Quick sync: beta users are tripping over the compact diff list in Prompt Sets. Main issues: approve CTA is ambiguous ("Approve" vs "Approve selected"), keyboard focus lands on the bulk action menu instead of the first diff, and mobile density makes comments hard to tap. Thoughts?

Sam (Design): Agree. Proposal: change CTA to "Approve selected (n)" when items selected. Make the bulk menu secondary so primary focus stays on list. Increase row tappable area on mobile and add a subtle divider when density is compact. I'll mock a compact + expanded state.

Diego (Frontend): Implementation caveats: changing CTA copy is trivial. Focus behavior needs roving tabindex so the first diff gets focus by default; will add a small focus ring for keyboard users. Mobile tappable area: increase hit target to 44px min.

Kya (A11y): For SRs: ensure when user selects items we announce "3 items selected. Approve selected button available." Use aria-live and update the button label with aria-label for clarity, e.g., "Approve selected, 3 items". Also ensure the bulk menu is reachable but not auto-focused.

Olivia (Support): Picking up from user reports: some customers thought "Approve" would approve the currently visible diff only. Changing to "Approve selected (n)" should reduce support tickets. Also add confirm copy that explains scope: "This approves the selected outputs in this run. Actions are reversible for 5 minutes."

Sam (Design): For confirm microcopy: short modal title "Approve selected outputs?" body "This will approve X selected outputs in this run. You can undo for 5 minutes from Run activity." Primary button "Approve X" Secondary "Cancel". Avoid scary words like "irreversible" to reduce anxiety.

Diego (Frontend): I'll implement CTA label changes, roving tabindex for list, and mobile hit area. Will add e2e that asserts SR announcement string and that focus lands on first diff.

Kya (A11y): Add keyboard shortcut hint in the help panel (e.g., "Select visible: S, Approve selected: Shift+A"). Ensure shortcuts are optional and can be disabled in Settings.

Nora (PM): Decision: ship copy + focus + mobile hit target in the next patch. Modal confirmation copy as proposed. Accessibility checklist required before merge. Thanks team.

Sam (Design): Mock uploaded: https://figma.com/file/placeholder/compact-diff-approve (placeholder). Comments invite.

Diego (Frontend): I'll open a PR tomorrow with tests and aria updates. Please tag Kya for review.

Olivia (Support): I'll update the KB article and churn a short release note about the CTA copy change to avoid confusion.

Kya (A11y): Will do a quick SR pass on the PR. If anything unexpected appears, I'll flag it.

Nora (PM): Awesome. Action items: Sam mock, Diego PR, Kya review, Olivia KB. Ship patch this week.
